verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יוּשַׁ֥ר הַשִּׁיר־ הַזֶּ֖ה בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֑ה עִ֣יר עָז־ לָ֔נוּ יְשׁוּעָ֥ה יָשִׁ֖ית חוֹמ֥וֹת וָחֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū yū·šar haš·šîr- haz·zeh bə·’e·reṣ yə·hū·ḏāh ‘îr ‘āz- lā·nū yə·šū·‘āh yā·šîṯ ḥō·w·mō·wṯ wā·ḥêl
verses.literal: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah We have a strong city salvation is established as its walls and ramparts
verses.literalPt: NAQUELE dia se entoará este cântico na terra de Judá: Temos uma cidade forte, a que Deus pôs a salvação por muros e antemuros.

verses.original: פִּתְח֖וּ שְׁעָרִ֑ים וְיָבֹ֥א גוֹי־ צַדִּ֖יק שֹׁמֵ֥ר אֱמֻנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: piṯ·ḥū šə·‘ā·rîm wə·yā·ḇō ḡō·w- ṣad·dîq šō·mêr ’ĕ·mu·nîm
verses.literal: Open the gates so a righteous nation may enter one that remains faithful
verses.literalPt: Abri as portas, para que entre nelas a nação justa, que observa a verdade.

verses.original: יֵ֣צֶר סָמ֔וּךְ תִּצֹּ֖ר שָׁל֣וֹם׀ שָׁל֑וֹם כִּ֥י בְךָ֖ בָּטֽוּחַ׃
verses.transliteration: yê·ṣer sā·mūḵ tiṣ·ṣōr šā·lō·wm šā·lō·wm kî ḇə·ḵā bā·ṭū·aḥ
verses.literal: You will keep in perfect peace . . . the steadfast of mind because he trusts in You
verses.literalPt: Tu conservarás em paz aquele cuja mente está firme em ti; porque ele confia em ti.

verses.original: בִּטְח֥וּ בַֽיהוָ֖ה עֲדֵי־ עַ֑ד כִּ֚י בְּיָ֣הּ יְהוָ֔ה צ֖וּר עוֹלָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: biṭ·ḥū Yah·weh ‘ă·ḏê- ‘aḏ kî bə·yāh Yah·weh ṣūr ‘ō·w·lā·mîm
verses.literal: Trust in the LORD forever . . . because GOD the LORD is the Rock eternal
verses.literalPt: Confiai no SENHOR perpetuamente; porque o SENHOR DEUS é uma rocha eterna.

verses.original: כִּ֤י הֵשַׁח֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י מָר֔וֹם קִרְיָ֖ה נִשְׂגָּבָ֑ה יַשְׁפִּילֶ֤נָּה יַשְׁפִּילָהּ֙ עַד־ אֶ֔רֶץ יַגִּיעֶ֖נָּה עַד־ עָפָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kî hê·šaḥ yō·šə·ḇê mā·rō·wm qir·yāh niś·gā·ḇāh yaš·pî·len·nāh yaš·pî·lāh ‘aḏ- ’e·reṣ yag·gî·‘en·nāh ‘aḏ- ‘ā·p̄ār
verses.literal: For He has humbled those who dwell on high He lays the lofty city low He brings it down to the ground He casts it into the dust
verses.literalPt: Porque ele abate os que habitam no alto, na cidade elevada; humilha-a, humilha-a até ao chão, e derruba-a até ao pó.

verses.original: תִּרְמְסֶ֖נָּה רָ֑גֶל רַגְלֵ֥י עָנִ֖י פַּעֲמֵ֥י דַלִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: tir·mə·sen·nāh rā·ḡel raḡ·lê ‘ā·nî pa·‘ă·mê ḏal·lîm
verses.literal: Feet trample it down the feet of the oppressed the steps of the poor
verses.literalPt: O pé pisá-la-á; os pés dos aflitos, e os passos dos pobres.

verses.original: אֹ֥רַח לַצַּדִּ֖יק מֵֽישָׁרִ֑ים יָשָׁ֕ר מַעְגַּ֥ל צַדִּ֖יק תְּפַלֵּֽס׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·raḥ laṣ·ṣad·dîq mê·šā·rîm yā·šār ma‘·gal ṣad·dîq tə·p̄al·lês
verses.literal: The path of the righteous is level You clear a straight path for the upright
verses.literalPt: O caminho do justo é todo plano; tu retamente pesas o andar do justo.

verses.original: אַ֣ף אֹ֧רַח מִשְׁפָּטֶ֛יךָ יְהוָ֖ה קִוִּינ֑וּךָ לְשִׁמְךָ֥ וּֽלְזִכְרְךָ֖ תַּאֲוַת־ נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄ ’ō·raḥ miš·pā·ṭe·ḵā Yah·weh qiw·wî·nū·ḵā lə·šim·ḵā ū·lə·ziḵ·rə·ḵā ta·’ă·waṯ- nā·p̄eš
verses.literal: Yes we wait for You O LORD we walk in the path of Your judgments Your name and renown are the desire of our souls
verses.literalPt: Também no caminho dos teus juízos, SENHOR, te esperamos; no teu nome e na tua memória está o desejo da nossa alma.

verses.original: נַפְשִׁ֤י אִוִּיתִ֙יךָ֙ בַּלַּ֔יְלָה אַף־ רוּחִ֥י בְקִרְבִּ֖י אֲשַֽׁחֲרֶ֑ךָּ כִּ֞י כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר מִשְׁפָּטֶ֙יךָ֙ לָאָ֔רֶץ צֶ֥דֶק לָמְד֖וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: nap̄·šî ’iw·wî·ṯî·ḵā bal·lay·lāh ’ap̄- rū·ḥî ḇə·qir·bî ’ă·ša·ḥă·re·kā kî ka·’ă·šer miš·pā·ṭe·ḵā lā·’ā·reṣ ṣe·ḏeq lā·mə·ḏū yō·šə·ḇê ṯê·ḇêl
verses.literal: My soul longs for You in the night indeed my spirit seeks You at dawn For when Your judgments come upon the earth the people of the world learn righteousness
verses.literalPt: Com minha alma te desejei de noite, e com o meu espírito, que está dentro de mim, madrugarei a buscar-te; porque, havendo os teus juízos na terra, os moradores do mundo aprendem justiça.

verses.original: יֻחַ֤ן רָשָׁע֙ בַּל־ לָמַ֣ד צֶ֔דֶק בְּאֶ֥רֶץ נְכֹח֖וֹת יְעַוֵּ֑ל וּבַל־ יִרְאֶ֖ה גֵּא֥וּת יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: yu·ḥan rā·šā‘ bal- lā·maḏ ṣe·ḏeq bə·’e·reṣ nə·ḵō·ḥō·wṯ yə·‘aw·wêl ū·ḇal- yir·’eh gê·’ūṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Though grace is shown to the wicked man he does not learn righteousness In the land of righteousness he acts unjustly and fails to see the majesty of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Ainda que se mostre favor ao ímpio, nem por isso aprende a justiça; até na terra da retidão ele pratica a iniqüidade, e não atenta para a majestade do SENHOR.

verses.original: יְהוָ֛ה רָ֥מָה יָדְךָ֖ בַּל־ יֶחֱזָי֑וּן יֶחֱז֤וּ וְיֵבֹ֙שׁוּ֙ קִנְאַת־ עָ֔ם אַף־ אֵ֖שׁ צָרֶ֥יךָ תֹאכְלֵֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh rā·māh yā·ḏə·ḵā bal- ye·ḥĕ·zā·yūn ye·ḥĕ·zū wə·yê·ḇō·šū qin·’aṯ- ‘ām ’ap̄- ’êš ṣā·re·ḵā ṯō·ḵə·lêm
verses.literal: O LORD Your hand is upraised but they do not see it They will see Your zeal for Your people . . . and be put to shame The fire set for Your enemies will consume them
verses.literalPt: SENHOR, a tua mão está exaltada, mas nem por isso a vêem; vê-la-ão, porém, e confundir-se-ão por causa do zelo que tens do teu povo; e o fogo consumirá os teus adversários.

verses.original: יְהוָ֕ה תִּשְׁפֹּ֥ת שָׁל֖וֹם לָ֑נוּ כִּ֛י גַּ֥ם כָּֽל־ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ינוּ פָּעַ֥לְתָּ לָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh tiš·pōṯ šā·lō·wm lā·nū kî gam kāl- ma·‘ă·śê·nū pā·‘al·tā lā·nū
verses.literal: O LORD You will establish peace for us For . . . all that we have accomplished You have done for us
verses.literalPt: SENHOR, tu nos darás a paz, porque tu és o que fizeste em nós todas as nossas obras.

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ בְּעָל֥וּנוּ אֲדֹנִ֖ים זֽוּלָתֶ֑ךָ לְבַד־ בְּךָ֖ נַזְכִּ֥יר שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū bə·‘ā·lū·nū ’ă·ḏō·nîm zū·lā·ṯe·ḵā lə·ḇaḏ- bə·ḵā naz·kîr šə·me·ḵā
verses.literal: O LORD our God other lords besides You have ruled over us but Your name alone do we confess
verses.literalPt: Ó SENHOR Deus nosso, já outros senhores têm tido domínio sobre nós; porém, por ti só, nos lembramos de teu nome.

verses.original: מֵתִים֙ בַּל־ יִחְי֔וּ רְפָאִ֖ים בַּל־ יָקֻ֑מוּ לָכֵ֤ן פָּקַ֙דְתָּ֙ וַתַּשְׁמִידֵ֔ם וַתְּאַבֵּ֥ד כָּל־ זֵ֖כֶר לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mê·ṯîm bal- yiḥ·yū rə·p̄ā·’îm bal- yā·qu·mū lā·ḵên pā·qaḏ·tā wat·taš·mî·ḏêm wat·tə·’ab·bêḏ kāl- zê·ḵer lā·mōw
verses.literal: The dead will not live the departed spirits will not rise Therefore You have punished and destroyed them You have wiped out all memory of them
verses.literalPt: Morrendo eles, não tornarão a viver; falecendo, não ressuscitarão; por isso os visitaste e destruíste, e apagaste toda a sua memória.

verses.original: יָסַ֤פְתָּ לַגּוֹי֙ יְהוָ֔ה יָסַ֥פְתָּ לַגּ֖וֹי נִכְבָּ֑דְתָּ רִחַ֖קְתָּ כָּל־ קַצְוֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: yā·sap̄·tā lag·gō·w Yah·weh yā·sap̄·tā lag·gō·w niḵ·bā·ḏə·tā ri·ḥaq·tā kāl- qaṣ·wê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: You have enlarged the nation O LORD You have enlarged the nation You have gained glory for Yourself You have extended all the borders of the land
verses.literalPt: Tu, SENHOR, aumentaste a esta nação, tu aumentaste a esta nação, fizeste-te glorioso; alargaste todos os confins da terra.

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה בַּצַּ֣ר פְּקָד֑וּךָ צָק֣וּן לַ֔חַשׁ מוּסָרְךָ֖ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh baṣ·ṣar pə·qā·ḏū·ḵā ṣā·qūn la·ḥaš mū·sā·rə·ḵā lā·mōw
verses.literal: O LORD they sought You in their distress when You disciplined them they poured out a quiet prayer
verses.literalPt: Ó SENHOR, na angústia te buscaram; vindo sobre eles a tua correção, derramaram a sua oração secreta.

verses.original: כְּמ֤וֹ הָרָה֙ תַּקְרִ֣יב לָלֶ֔דֶת תָּחִ֥יל תִּזְעַ֖ק בַּחֲבָלֶ֑יהָ כֵּ֛ן הָיִ֥ינוּ מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kə·mōw hā·rāh taq·rîḇ lā·le·ḏeṯ tā·ḥîl tiz·‘aq ba·ḥă·ḇā·le·hā kên hā·yî·nū mip·pā·ne·ḵā Yah·weh
verses.literal: As a woman with child about to give birth writhes and cries out in pain so were we in Your presence O LORD
verses.literalPt: Como a mulher grávida, quando está próxima a sua hora, tem dores de parto, e dá gritos nas suas dores, assim fomos nós diante de ti, ó SENHOR!

verses.original: הָרִ֣ינוּ חַ֔לְנוּ כְּמ֖וֹ יָלַ֣דְנוּ ר֑וּחַ יְשׁוּעֹת֙ בַּל־ נַ֣עֲשֶׂה אֶ֔רֶץ וּבַֽל־ יִפְּל֖וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hā·rî·nū ḥal·nū kə·mōw yā·laḏ·nū rū·aḥ yə·šū·‘ōṯ bal- na·‘ă·śeh ’e·reṣ ū·ḇal- yip·pə·lū yō·šə·ḇê ṯê·ḇêl
verses.literal: We were with child we writhed in pain but we gave birth to wind We have given no salvation to the earth nor brought any life into the world
verses.literalPt: Bem concebemos nós e tivemos dores de parto, porém demos à luz o vento; livramento não trouxemos à terra, nem caíram os moradores do mundo.

verses.original: יִֽחְי֣וּ מֵתֶ֔יךָ נְבֵלָתִ֖י יְקוּמ֑וּן הָקִ֨יצוּ וְרַנְּנ֜וּ שֹׁכְנֵ֣י עָפָ֗ר כִּ֣י טַ֤ל אוֹרֹת֙ טַלֶּ֔ךָ וָאָ֖רֶץ רְפָאִ֥ים תַּפִּֽיל׃ס
verses.transliteration: yiḥ·yū mê·ṯe·ḵā nə·ḇê·lā·ṯî yə·qū·mūn hā·qî·ṣū wə·ran·nə·nū šō·ḵə·nê ‘ā·p̄ār kî ṭal ’ō·w·rōṯ ṭal·le·ḵā wā·’ā·reṣ rə·p̄ā·’îm tap·pîl
verses.literal: Your dead will live their bodies will rise Awake and sing you who dwell in the dust For your dew is like the dew of the morning and the earth will bring forth her dead
verses.literalPt: Os teus mortos e também o meu cadáver viverão e ressuscitarão; despertai e exultai, os que habitais no pó, porque o teu orvalho será como o orvalho das ervas, e a terra lançará de si os mortos.

verses.original: לֵ֤ךְ עַמִּי֙ בֹּ֣א בַחֲדָרֶ֔יךָ וּֽסְגֹ֥ר דְּלָתֶיךָ בַּעֲדֶ֑ךָ חֲבִ֥י כִמְעַט־ רֶ֖גַע עַד־ יַעֲבוֹר זָֽעַם׃
verses.transliteration: lêḵ ‘am·mî bō ḇa·ḥă·ḏā·re·ḵā ū·sə·ḡōr də·lå̄·ṯɛ·ḵå̄ ba·‘ă·ḏe·ḵā ḥă·ḇî ḵim·‘aṭ- re·ḡa‘ ‘aḏ- ya·ʿă·ḇōr zā·‘am
verses.literal: Go my people enter your rooms and shut your doors behind you Hide yourselves a little while until the wrath has passed
verses.literalPt: Vai, pois, povo meu, entra nos teus quartos, e fecha as tuas portas sobre ti; esconde-te só por um momento, até que passe a ira.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ יֹצֵ֣א מִמְּקוֹמ֔וֹ לִפְקֹ֛ד עֲוֺ֥ן יֹֽשֵׁב־ הָאָ֖רֶץ עָלָ֑יו וְגִלְּתָ֤ה הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֶת־ דָּמֶ֔יהָ וְלֹֽא־ תְכַסֶּ֥ה ע֖וֹד עַל־ הֲרוּגֶֽיהָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- hin·nêh Yah·weh yō·ṣê mim·mə·qō·w·mōw lip̄·qōḏ ‘ă·wōn yō·šêḇ- hā·’ā·reṣ ‘ā·lāw wə·ḡil·lə·ṯāh hā·’ā·reṣ ’eṯ- dā·me·hā wə·lō- ṯə·ḵas·seh ‘ō·wḏ ‘al- hă·rū·ḡe·hā
verses.literal: For behold the LORD is coming out of His dwelling to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity . . . The earth will reveal her bloodshed and will no longer . . . conceal her slain
verses.literalPt: Porque eis que o SENHOR sairá do seu lugar, para castigar os moradores da terra, por causa da sua iniqüidade, e a terra descobrirá o seu sangue, e não encobrirá mais os seu mortos.
